# Candidate Assessment: DOC_resume_ninety vs. DOC_posting_ten_five

## Mandatory Requirements

| # | Requirement | On Résumé? |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | Python | ✅ Yes |
| 2 | SQL | ✅ Yes |
| 3 | Linux administration | ✅ Yes |
| 4 | Git | ✅ Yes |
| 5 | REST API design | ✅ Yes |
| 6 | Unit testing | ✅ Yes |
| 7 | CI pipelines | ✅ Yes |
| 8 | Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform, Ansible, Helm | ✅ Yes (all five) |
| 9 | Kafka | ✅ Yes |
| 10 | GraphQL | ❌ No |

## Mandatory Match Percentage

Item 8 bundles five technologies, so the score depends on how it's counted:

- **By numbered item:** 9 of 10 = **90%**
- **By individual skill:** 13 of 14 = **92.9%**

Either way, the result is above the 85% threshold.

## Nice-to-Have
None of the five (Grafana, Prometheus, technical writing, mentoring, public speaking) appear on the résumé. As instructed, this does not affect the outcome.

## Outcome
**Proceed.** The only mandatory gap is **GraphQL**, which may be worth checking in an interview.
